enunciado: Declare an array of 6 ints with {4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42}. Show it with a printArray procedure, traverse it backwards and show the elements at even positions.
objetivos: Traverse with indexes forward, backward and with steps
pistas: Valid indexes go from 0 to size - 1.
Backwards: for (int i = N - 1; i >= 0; i--).
Even positions: advance with i = i + 2.
